title: My Coworker Camped Out for Black Friday... It Was Cheaper Online 😭 #shorts
description:
Dre left Thanksgiving before the pie. Slept in a parking lot. Won the TV. Then Skip checked his phone. 😭

Tag the friend who would STILL camp out. 👇

"Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth" (Matthew 6:19). Go eat the pie.
